# Fade audio in and out

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/volume-fades`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). A 1 to 3 s fade at the start and 2 to 5 s at the end sounds deliberate.

## Details

### When to use
Music starts or stops abruptly.
### What a pro does and why
A 1 to 3 s fade at the start and 2 to 5 s at the end sounds deliberate. Volume keyframes on the clip are linear gain (1 = unchanged).
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Fade music out",
  "reason": "The music ends abruptly, so a fade out lets it finish smoothly",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "set_keyframes", "clipId": "CLIP_ID", "property": "volume", "keyframes": [{"t": 0, "value": 0, "ease": "easeOut"}, {"t": 1.5, "value": 1, "ease": "linear"}, {"t": 55, "value": 1, "ease": "easeIn"}, {"t": 59, "value": 0, "ease": "linear"}]}
  ]
}
```
The last keyframe sits at the clip length from the digest.
### How to adjust
Longer ending: start the fade 6 s before the end. Quieter overall: values 0.6 instead of 1.
